name: B10-0113/2025 (ESN) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution from a political group. It does not change any law. It asks the European Parliament to take note of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu's challenge to Nigeria's blasphemy laws. It also asks the European Union to reject adding "hate speech" to the list of EU crimes, and calls on the EU and Nigeria to work together against illegal migration.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament has only been asked to state a position.
- It concerns Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, Nigeria, and EU migration policy.
- Parliament would vote on the text; it is not binding.
